lens 0.0->1.0
  out: {
    if (in.boolish & string) != _|_ {
      out.properbool = in.boolish == "true"
    }
    if (in.boolish & bool) != _|_ {
      out.properbool <- in.boolish
    }
  }
  lacuna LossyFieldMapping {
    when (in.boolish & string) != _|_ && (in.boolish & ("true" | "false")) == _|_
    source boolish = in.boolish
    target properbool = out.properbool
    message "boolish was a string but neither \"true\" nor \"false\"; fallback to treating as false"
  }
lens 1.0->0.0
  out: {
    out.boolish <- in.properbool
  }
